name: Google Flow
tagline: Google's AI filmmaking tool: generate cinematic clips and images, then combine them into scenes.
about: Flow is built on Google's generative video and image models. You create clips from prompts or images and assemble them into longer scenes with consistent characters and style.
pros: Built on Google's video models, with sound.
Keeps characters and style consistent across clips.
cons: Uses credits from a Google AI plan.
